members.name: id
members.doc: Stable identity. A ridge that survives a data change morphs into its new shape.

members.name: values
members.doc: Raw observations. The ridge is a smoothed density of these values.

types.name: RidgelineProps
types.doc: Use a ridgeline to compare the shape of many distributions at once, such as daily temperatures by month or response times by region.

members.name: series
members.doc: One ridge per series, drawn top to bottom.

members.name: label
members.doc: What is measured, such as "Daily highs in Zurich". Names the chart for assistive technology.

members.name: unit
members.doc: Unit after each value, such as "°C".

members.name: domain
members.doc: Value range of the axis. Defaults to the data with a little room on each side.

members.name: overlap
members.doc: How far a ridge may rise into the rows above, in row heights.

members.name: rowHeight
members.doc: Height of one row in pixels.

members.name: bandwidth
members.doc: Smoothing in value units. Defaults to Silverman's rule per series.

members.name: tint
members.doc: Shades each ridge by its median, from a light tint to the full first series color, and shows the scale under the axis.

members.name: active
members.doc: Controlled id of the lifted ridge.
